If the id is unknown, `host` is nil and `save_host` will call `host.host = ...` / `host.category_id = ...`, and `destroy` will call `host.destroy`, both causing a 500. The new spec (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb) indeed only asserts inheritance and does not cover these behaviors, so this defect is not caught.
